images.title: Where autumn turns the wheel
images.caption: Glade Creek Grist Mill, Babcock State Park, West Virginia
images.desc: Surrounded by a patchwork of red, orange, and gold, Glade Creek Grist Mill stands above the rocky waters of Glade Creek in West Virginia's Babcock State Park. Although it looks like a relic from the pioneer era, the mill is actually a carefully crafted tribute to Appalachia's milling heritage.
